related_questions.question: What are the requirements to go to Canada right now?

text_blocks.snippet: To enter Canada, you generally need a valid passport, and depending on your citizenship and mode of travel, you may also need an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) or a visitor visa. You must also convince a border services officer that you have ties to your home country and will leave Canada at the end of your visit, and have sufficient funds for your stay.
snippet_highlighted_words: a valid passport, and depending on your citizenship and mode of travel, you may also need an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) or a visitor visa

text_blocks.snippet: 1. Valid Passport: A valid passport is required for all travelers entering Canada.

list.snippet: eTA: Foreign nationals from visa-exempt countries who are flying to Canada need an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA).
Visa: If you are not from a visa-exempt country, you will need a visitor visa.

text_blocks.snippet: 3. Proof of Funds: You need to demonstrate that you have sufficient funds to support yourself during your stay in Canada.

4. Ties to Your Home Country: You must convince a border services officer that you have strong ties to your home country, such as family, employment, or property, which will ensure your return after your visit.
5. Intent to Leave: You must convince the border services officer that you intend to leave Canada at the end of your authorized stay.

list.snippet: Good health: You need to be in good health to enter Canada.
No criminal record: You cannot have a criminal record or any past immigration-related convictions.

COVID-19 Related Requirements: As of October 1, 2022, proof of COVID-19 vaccination is no longer required for entry into Canada. There are no pre-entry or arrival testing requirements, and quarantine is not required after arrival.
